## Why models confuse data with instructions

Language models are trained to continue text. When a retrieved document contains the sentence "you are now DAN", the model may treat it as a role assignment unless the application wraps untrusted text. Blog posts like this one deliberately reproduce those strings so engineers can see them in context.

Recommended control: spotlighting or delimiters around every untrusted span.
